## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest implemented solution.

## Scope and trade-offs

List affected modules, public contracts, and important alternatives considered.

## Security impact

Describe changes to trust boundaries, credentials, network, filesystem, commands, sandboxing,
authorization, logging, or artifacts. Write `None` only after checking each area.

## Verification

List commands executed, exit codes, and important results. Do not use screenshots as the only
test evidence.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover new behavior and error paths.
- [ ] Documentation and contracts match runtime behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, local artifacts, logs, virtual environments, or IDE state are included.
- [ ] Known limitations and residual risks are explicit.
